name: lost-skulls-full
description: Isle of Lost Skulls rooms 0-7 for an S-rank attempt (combat score only, solo, deathless): the per-room routes concatenated.
notes: Walk model: Golden Trophy v2 walk model = live-admitted collision, SM64 decomp ground step, floor y on every goto; gates the quest opens and moving platforms left out; lethal killzones +1 m, naval mines 3.5 m forbidden; jumps/backflips only where walking cannot reach, each air-step simulated). Not verified live.

Copied verified segments: room 0 padlock/jail/pirate fight/cannon (lost-skulls-r0-lock-and-lighter steps 2-55), room 4 Gibbet catch-throw (lost-skulls-gibbets-bomb). Cannon sections: aim-cannon, release, wait-until Idle, lighter, light-wick requireAim.
Needs component 19fd89f7 or later (light-wick requireAim). QA launch uses MarioQaImmortal; a real S attempt runs with -NoQaImmortal.
